# Team MCPs in team marketplaces Admins can now configure Team MCP servers once and distribute them across cloud agents, the agents window, IDE, and CLI.
When an admin sets up Team MCP servers for cloud agents, they can make those same servers available in a team marketplace from Dashboard -> Integrations & MCP .
